draft.summary: NFL.com graded him 6.31, the 39th-best grade among 259 2021 draftees and 5th of 34 at DE. He lasted until pick 118, well after his grade rank (39th): he slid relative to the published grade. Published comparison: Leonard Floyd. Testing was middle of the pack for his position, with no result in the top or bottom 20%. College production: 8 sacks in 2020, 7th of 33 DEs in his class with stats.

current.summary: Year 6 pro, currently with the New Orleans Saints. 54 career games and 0 starts over 4 completed seasons, plus 4 so far in 2026. Producing near his peak: 1 AV in 2025 against a career-best 1 in 2021. Strengths in 2025: missed tackle rate 4.1% (76th percentile). Weak spots: approximate value 1 (14th percentile). Versus the typical Year-5 edge rusher who played: 2.0 sacks against a median of 3.5, below the norm.
